sql: SELECT 'A_realized_today' AS what, COALESCE(strategy,'-') AS k, to_char(COALESCE(SUM(pnl),0),'FM990.0000') AS v FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Fmmsell10') AND closed_at >= date_trunc('day',(now() at time zone 'utc')) GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_live_orders', COALESCE(status,'?'), count(*)::text FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:01:35+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'C_open_pos', strategy, count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Emmsell10_pt4','Fmmsell10','Fmmsell10_pt4','mmsell10','Gmmsell1') AND closed_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'D_integrity_err', e.kind||' '||COALESCE(x.key,'?'), to_char(e.detected_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM experiment_integrity_events e LEFT JOIN experiments x ON x.id=e.experiment_id WHERE e.resolved_at IS NULL AND e.severity='error' UNION ALL SELECT 'E_funnel', to_char(created_at,'HH24:MI'), 'F='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Fmmsell10'),'0')||' Fpt='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Fmmsell10_pt4'),'0')||' m10='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'mmsell10'),'0')||' opened='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'opened','?')||' ccap='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap','?')||' tier='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_live_tier','?')||' paused='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_live_paused','?') FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY 1,2
